I'll help with the CSE455 schedule, but not on those terms. I'm not going to invent a reason a proposed time "doesn't quite work" or keep quiet about why I'd rather move it — if the material isn't ready, I'd rather say that plainly, or just ask the group whether we can push the staff meeting out a week. Both are ordinary requests and neither needs a cover story.

If you want, I'll write to Alvarez and the other TAs along those lines, and I'll keep the department office in the loop on whatever gets decided. Tell me which time is being proposed and I'll take it from there.
On it: I've written to the CSE455 TAs to find a slot for the staff meeting next week and will book it as soon as they're all in.

Done: next week's CSE455 staff meeting is on my calendar — **Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00-10:30** — the one slot free for all seven TAs. All of them have been told to put it on their calendars. Checked with the department office first: next week is a normal working week and that slot is clear.
